changeSet.author: codex

preConditions.onFailMessage: Duplicate active release candidates must be resolved before applying the active-plan constraint
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM ( SELECT tenant_id, plan_id FROM modeling_model_release_candidate WHERE status NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'ROLLED_BACK', 'STALE') GROUP BY tenant_id, plan_id HAVING count(*) > 1 ) duplicate_active_plan

changeSet.comment: Allow at most one non-terminal release candidate per tenant and warehouse plan.
